acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Elemental Colossus, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Mantle-Orbit Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Large broad floating upper body with exactly two integrated arms, three articulated mantle sections, a shuttered core, and no feet, worn armor, or independent rock anatomy.
Signature mechanic: Mantle Orbit: three affinity-built mantle sections widen into a barrier ring, expose the central shutter, and then converge through three marked lanes.
battlefieldDuty: Control encounter space by shifting three articulated mantle sections between a barrier and converging marked lanes.
constructionDimensions: Vermilion living combustion, a yellow-hot inner seam, controlled ember grain, black exhaust markers, and restrained heat distortion form the complete body.
The body expands and curls upward during motion; higher forms route combustion through their established channels, mantle sections, and core facets without acquiring extra anatomy.
counterplay: Cross a widening mantle gap and strike the exposed shutter before the three sections converge. Affinity signal: The active throat, channel, mantle shutter, or core facet turns pale and exhausts to black immediately after ignition, exposing the established opening.
forbiddenTreatments: Uniform orange glow without material structure
Fire pasted over a neutral body
Premature high-tier mantle or facet anatomy
Magma, lightning, or another dual-affinity material
identityInvariants: Every form is organized around one readable binding seed or core, with no flesh, worn armor, ordinary clothing, handheld weapon, or fixed face.
The T1 Wisp is a small asymmetric teardrop or flame-like shape without limbs; T2–T5 develop a legless hovering upper body with exactly two coherent arm channels and a tapering lower body.
Affinity substance forms the complete load-bearing body, limbs, mantle, and directional wake rather than appearing as a colored exterior aura or decorative overlay.
Form coherence, core structure, and spatial control progress from one wandering Wisp to a four-facet Sovereign while the active telegraph and exposed counterplay remain readable.
telegraph: The broad hovering body stills, three mantle sections separate along visible seams, and the central shutter turns toward the open gap.
